reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing assistant presets, personality, local memory, experience settings, user profiles, avatars, and Hana assistant migration through a web interface.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过网页管理助手预设、人格、记忆、经验、用户资料和头像，并支持从本机 Hana 助手迁移数据。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing assistant presets, personalities, local memories, experience settings, user profiles, and avatars through a web interface, with local Hana assistant migration support.

capabilities: Reads and writes local assistant presets and user profile files
Creates, edits, reorders, selects, and deletes assistant configurations
Manages assistant memory and experience settings and displays memory snapshots
Imports assistant identity, memory, experience, and avatar data from a local Hana directory
Uploads, crops, removes, and stores assistant and user avatars
Uses a configured model to compile memories
